page_title: KOR 2-3 GHA | South Korea v Ghana 28/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Referee Anthony Taylor has finally had enough of Paulo Bento and gives him a straight RED CARD!
90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+11' Kyung-Won Kwon (South Korea) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
90+10' Kang-In Lee (South Korea) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ghana will have a goal kick.
90+10' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90+10' Kang-In Lee (South Korea) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+9' Kang-In Lee (South Korea) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+8' Inaki Williams (Ghana) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+7' Gue-Sung Cho (South Korea) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+6' Jin-Su Kim (South Korea) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+5' The free kick into the penalty area from Kang-In Lee (South Korea) is cleared.
90+5' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Ghana) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Anthony Taylor no option but to blow his whistle.
90+5' Kang-In Lee (South Korea) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

90+5' Gue-Sung Cho (South Korea) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the top left corner. Lawrence Ati-Zigi is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
90+4' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90+4' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kyung-Won Kwon (South Korea) comes onto the pitch for Min-Jae Kim.

90+2' What a save from Lawrence Ati-Zigi! Sang-Ho Na (South Korea) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
90+1' Young-Gwon Kim (South Korea) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
90+1' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
90' The resulting corner from Kang-In Lee (South Korea) is cleared by the defence.
90' The attendance is 43983.
88' That's the end of the game for Gideon Mensah, who is replaced by Abdul-Rahman Baba (Ghana).
87' Gideon Mensah (Ghana) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
86' Jin-Su Kim (South Korea) gets on the end of a nice cross, but places his close-range header well wide of the left post.
86' Salis Abdul Samed (Ghana) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Anthony Taylor saw the whole situation.
84' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Jin-Su Kim (South Korea), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ghana.
83' Daniel-Kofi Kyereh (Ghana) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

83' Salis Abdul Samed (Ghana) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and South Korea will have a goal kick.
83' Substitution. Alexander Djiku (Ghana) has come on for Mohammed Kudus.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Woo-Young Jung leaves the pitch and Ui-Jo Hwang (South Korea) comes on.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tariq Lamptey trots off the pitch and is replaced by Denis Odoi (Ghana).
78' Otto Addo has decided to substitute Andre Ayew and he is replaced by Daniel-Kofi Kyereh (Ghana).
78' Here comes a substitution. Kamaldeen Sulemana (Ghana) is brought on as a substitute for Jordan Ayew.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Young-Gwon Kim (South Korea) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' Jin-Su Kim (South Korea) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
76' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
76' Kang-In Lee (South Korea) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
76' South Korea failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

75' Kang-In Lee (South Korea) unloads a good strike from the free kick just outside the box. His low effort towards the bottom right corner is stopped by Lawrence Ati-Zigi, who pulls off a glorious save! South Korea will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
73' Tariq Lamptey (Ghana) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
70' South Korea enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
68' 2 - 3 Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
68' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kang-In Lee (South Korea) brought his opponent down.
67' The game is interrupted as Inaki Williams (Ghana) is flagged offside.
66' In-Beom Hwang (South Korea) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
65' Sang-Ho Na (South Korea) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
64' In-Beom Hwang (South Korea) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
63' Anthony Taylor blows for a foul after In-Beom Hwang (South Korea) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
61' 2 - 2 Goal! Gue-Sung Cho (South Korea) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Jin-Su Kim and easily beat the keeper with a header into the middle of the goal from close range. 2:2.
58' 1 - 2 Gue-Sung Cho (South Korea) heads the ball low into the middle after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
57' The referee allows time for a substitution. Chang-Hoon Kwon will be replaced by Kang-In Lee (South Korea).
57' Jin-Su Kim (South Korea) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
56' Jordan Ayew (Ghana) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
55' Jordan Ayew (Ghana) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
55' Andre Ayew (Ghana) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

53' Gue-Sung Cho (South Korea) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the top left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Lawrence Ati-Zigi, who pulls off a stunning save!
52' Jin-Su Kim (South Korea) is able to continue to play.
51' The game is interrupted now, Jin-Su Kim (South Korea) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
50' Tariq Lamptey (Ghana) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for South Korea.
50' Gideon Mensah (Ghana) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
49' Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
48' South Korea are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
46' Gue-Sung Cho (South Korea) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
46' Paulo Bento has made a change at the break. Sang-Ho Na has come on in place of Woo-Yeong Jeong (South Korea).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Thomas Partey (Ghana), but it's just wide of the left post.
45+5' Jordan Ayew (Ghana) will take a corner kick.
45+5' Inaki Williams (Ghana) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ghana.
45+2' Jordan Ayew (Ghana) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
45+2' The ball is cleared after Jordan Ayew (Ghana) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45+1' Woo-Young Jung (South Korea) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Ghana will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Moon-Hwan Kim (South Korea) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
44' Some great controlled play and passing from South Korea. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
40' An attempted cross from Jin-Su Kim (South Korea) is cleared.
38' The linesman signals that Heung-Min Son (South Korea) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
37' The ball possession is 55:45.

34' 0 - 2 Goal! Jordan Ayew hands Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
32' Inaki Williams (Ghana) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Anthony Taylor who sees an offensive foul.
31' Ghana hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
29' The referee blows his whistle as Mohammed Salisu (Ghana) was too aggressive in his challenge.
28' Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
27' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Woo-Young Jung (South Korea) for his blatant foul.
27' Referee Anthony Taylor points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Ghana players celebrate.
25' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Ghana players aren’t happy.
24' 0 - 1 Goal! 0:1. The ball rebounds to Mohammed Salisu (Ghana) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
24' Jordan Ayew (Ghana) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
23' Poor challenge! In-Beom Hwang (South Korea) is penalised for tripping and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle.
23' A cross from Tariq Lamptey (Ghana) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
23' Inaki Williams (Ghana) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
21' Daniel Amartey (Ghana) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
20' Jin-Su Kim (South Korea) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Jin-Su Kim (South Korea) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
19' Woo-Yeong Jeong (South Korea) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
18' The corner from Heung-Min Son (South Korea) is hurriedly cleared.
17' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
17' Jin-Su Kim (South Korea) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
16' The current number of corner kicks is 5:0.
15' Salis Abdul Samed (Ghana) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
14' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Woo-Yeong Jeong (South Korea).
13' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
12' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
12' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
11' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
9' Chang-Hoon Kwon (South Korea) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
9' Min-Jae Kim (South Korea) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
8' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) will take the corner.

8' Woo-Yeong Jeong (South Korea) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and South Korea manage to earn a corner.
7' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
6' Tariq Lamptey (Ghana) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
4' Gue-Sung Cho (South Korea) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
4' Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
3' The game is interrupted. Woo-Young Jung (South Korea) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
2' Moon-Hwan Kim (South Korea) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
